sentences.en: Please pack the disks and hard copies into the briefcase.
sentences.zh: 请将磁盘和纸质副本装入公文包。

sentences.en: Did you give a copy of the disk to anyone?
sentences.zh: 你把磁盘拷贝给了别人吗？

sentences.en: Call Disk Gás and ask for a new cylinder.
sentences.zh: 打电话给Disk Gás，要求更换一个新气瓶。
